annotations.title: Which Shopify store this brand works with

description: The Shopify store this brand works with: the one connected in Connectors ▸ Shopify (via 'linked', paid from this Hermoso account) or the store this account was installed on from the Shopify App Store (via 'app_store'). For each: live (the Hermoso app is still installed), missing (permissions the store has not approved yet, such as read_orders and read_customers for a store that installed before they were added) and openUrl, where the store's owner opens Hermoso in their Shopify admin and approves them. Nothing connected: connect_shopify_store. Read-only, free.
